# CWE-798: password passed to sshpass on the command line.
# ruleid: detected-ssh-password
sshpass -p 's3cr3t-deploy' scp build.tar.gz user@example.com:
# ruleid: detected-ssh-password
sshpass -p "an0ther-secret" rsync -a out/ user@example.com:out/
# ok: detected-ssh-password
ssh -i deploy.pem user@example.com
# ok: detected-ssh-password
# deployments authenticate with an SSH key, never a password
